invariants.contract: GET /api/libraries/:id/authors without limit and page answers {authors} with every fixture author: id, asin, name, description, imagePath, libraryId, addedAt, updatedAt, numBooks and lastFirst.
With limit and page the answer is {results, total, limit, page, sortBy, sortDesc, filterBy, minified, include}; two pages of two cover the three authors in the requested order and total stays 3.

An author with a description and no books is listed with numBooks 0 for an admin and left out for a non-admin user. A user without explicit-content access does not count explicit books, a tag user in allow mode counts only books with a selected tag and one in deny mode only books without; authors left with no visible book are not listed, while an admin sees every count.
GET authors of a podcast library answers an empty authors list, and an empty page with total 0 when paginated.
GET authors answers 401 without a token, 403 without library access (also for an unknown id), 404 for an unknown id, and 400 for a negative limit or a fractional page.
